e-4683.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
e-4683.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/14671e805c18814b31d0c65d0e53c60aae1cf52c60ad8dd146d8a3f4bc823915.png)
e-4683.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that every variable has a coefficient:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/e0318c549ab4aa25bf2decb41e45e296406d699706c03aff7ea44724d20edece.png)

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & -2 \
		0 & 2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$

e-4684.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
e-4684.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/a5abba041a61cad76d43d5bb13d0fd4e873eb2daf2282e8d9828b8ab79fe2ba0.png)
e-4684.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/2f9ae37920ec528a700715658900bbbf3ec4c855767bf06f79d044f488a8bbf2.png)

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\left\lbrack
	\matrix {
		1 & 1 & -3 \
		-7 & -1 & 1 \
                2 & 1 & -2 
	}
	\right\rbrack
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071100/assets/af1499610c0c312a1f5c50d99967a004ae6b3042c3a88ca20a86f922b28aaaff.png)

content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}5x-8y+z=-1 \\ 9y=2 \\ 3x-y-8z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}5x-8y+z=-1 \\ 0x+9y+0z=2 \\ 3x-y-8z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}5 & \,\,\,-8 & 1 \\ 0 & 9 & 0 \\ 3 & \,\,\,-1 & \,\,\,-8\end{aligned}]
$$

after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x=6 \\ 9x+4y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+0y=6 \\ 9x+4y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 9 & 4\end{aligned}]

after.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+3y=7 \\ 2x=4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered  $x,y$ 
 on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x+3y=7 \\ 2x+0y=4\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

content.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x+3y=7 \\ 2x=4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered  $x,y$ 
 on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x+3y=7 \\ 2x+0y=4\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-5=3y \\ 6+y=4x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-3y=5 \\ -4x+y=-6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & 5 \\ -4 & 1 & -6\end{aligned}]
$$

content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-5=3y \\ 6+y=4x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-3y=5 \\ -4x+y=-6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & 5 \\ -4 & 1 & -6\end{aligned}]
$$

content.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4x-y=4 \\ 8x=-7\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
content.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x-y=4 \\ 8x+0y=-7\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 8 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 & 4 \\ 8 & 0 & -7\end{aligned}]
$$

after.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
after.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+y+z=4 \\ x+0y+z=9\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}6 & 1 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 & 9\end{aligned}]
$$
